accessibility.label: Device control
accessibility.title: Let agents click and type
accessibility.purpose: Agents move the pointer, type and press buttons in the windows you share. macOS calls this Accessibility.

screenRecording.label: Screen Recording
screenRecording.title: Let agents see your screen
screenRecording.purpose: Agents see the windows and screens you share in a chat — nothing else, and only while it is shared.

fullDiskAccess.label: Full Disk Access
fullDiskAccess.title: Let agents open protected folders
fullDiskAccess.purpose: Imports sign-ins from your browser profiles and lets agents read Mail, Messages and other folders macOS locks away, when a task needs it.

steps.fullDisk1: Click Open System Settings. Godmode also shows its app in the Finder.
steps.fullDisk2: Drag {{app}} from the Finder into the list, or click + and pick it from Applications.
steps.fullDisk3: Switch {{app}} on, then restart Godmode once.
steps.allow1: Click Allow. If macOS shows a dialog, choose Open System Settings.
steps.allow2: Switch {{app}} on under {{pane}}. macOS asks for your Mac password.
steps.allow3: Done. This page notices on its own.
steps.screenRecording3: If macOS offers Quit & Reopen, choose Later — Godmode picks it up by itself.

guide.nothingToSetUp: Nothing to set up on this computer.

pane.runsFrom: Godmode runs from {{app}} right now, so macOS asks about {{app}}. Switch that on, or start the Godmode app instead.
pane.helpToggle: Switched on, but still not allowed?
pane.helpReset: After an update macOS can keep an old entry: the switch shows on, but no longer counts. Reset it and switch it on again.
pane.helpManual: After an update macOS can keep an old entry: the switch shows on, but no longer counts. Remove {{app}} with −, add it again with +, and switch it on.
